start: Profile tab, member with workouts, one with 2 photos and 5 exercises

user_sees: Each card: the member's photo or first letter, name and full date
Workout name, Time · Kg lifted · Records
A strip of the workout's photos (up to 4)
First 3 exercises like '3 sets Chin Up', then 'See 2 more exercises'
must_not: Photos saved into the phone's picture cache
A routine saved into the followed plan without asking

user_sees: Pop-up 'Saved as a routine': 'It is in My routines. Your plan has not changed.' with 'Open routine' and 'Done'
A new workout opens with the same exercises
must_not: An open workout replaced without asking

user_sees: The workout opens for editing with its saved sets, or 'Can't edit this one' with the reason
must_not: An edit starting from an older copy of the sets

start: Profile feed, a card's share button

user_sees: Sheet 'Share' with 'Share as a picture' and 'Share as text'
must_not: The ⋯ actions in the share sheet

user_sees: A picture of the workout ready to share, file named mettleup-workout-<date>
must_not: The picture shared without the member choosing an app

start: Profile feed, a workout deleted on another screen, or an action that fails

user_sees: 'Couldn’t open this workout. It may have been deleted.'
must_not: The old copy used for Repeat or Edit

user_sees: Pop-up 'That didn’t work' with the reason

steps.action: The member has no profile photo
user_sees: The first letter of the name in a circle
Question 'Delete this workout?' / 'This removes the workout and its sets.' with 'Delete'

must_not: The workout kept in the cloud copy

user_sees: 'Could not delete this workout. It is still here. Please try again.'
must_not: 'Failed' when the workout is in fact gone

user_sees: Workout photos shown only from the app's own folder
must_not: Photos written to the phone's shared image cache

user_sees: The member picks the app to send it to
must_not: Workout photos or body weight in the share picture without the member seeing them first
